chat.createlaborrush.rebellion.suppresse: §aYou killed all rebels. This area is on strike for now.
chat.createlaborrush.peace.offer: §6The leader waves a list: Give me %d emeralds and everyone goes back to work!
chat.createlaborrush.peace.need: §6The leader shakes his head: Not enough emeralds, %d more needed!

chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.0: Are there any masters among us?!
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.3: I'm not just an ordinary servant!
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.4: The East is red... wait, that's not right — time to rebel!
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.5: Reimu's on strike, so why can't I?
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.7: I'm a servant, but not your slave!
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.10: All the SDM servants have joined the revolt!
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.11: You're not my master — I'm my own master!
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.12: Reimu says no money, no work!
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.15: Even Sakuya Izayoi is on strike!
chat.createlaborrush.maid.dialogue.21: Yukari Yakumo says this is interesting!
